title: Readiness foundation
summary: Sleep, physical movement, and general recovery support the focus, consistency, and reaction quality that aiming practice depends on.
cues: Treat consistency problems partly as readiness problems when recovery is poor
Use short movement and reset habits before hard blocks
Protect sleep before expecting stable reaction quality
failureModes: Trying to solve every variance problem with more scenario volume
Ignoring fatigue while expecting normal reading speed and control
